offset.description: 章节内的原文字偏移；不是 location.start/end，也不是页面编号。

limit.description: 本次读取的最多字符数，范围 1–8000；hasMore 时以返回的 location.end 作为下一次 offset。

edits.description: For revise-document, prefer exact local replacements: old_text/new_text and explicit replace_all only when wanted. Match the exact read revision; omit title to preserve it. All edits match the original together, not sequential outputs. Do not also send markdown. Missing, ambiguous or overlapping matches fail atomically; reread instead of guessing. Full markdown plus title is for an intentional whole-body rewrite.
